✅ **Row-level**: Hash for each of 91 rows (before/after)

- Headers: "Object Date" → "Object_Date" (underscores)
- Titles: 15 rows had quote normalization (removed outer quotes, standardized escaping)
- All other fields: Dates, URLs, Object Numbers preserved exactly

### **Quality Assurance:**
- ✅ 100% data integrity (no data loss)
- ✅ UTF-8 encoding preserved (French accents, Chinese characters intact)
- ✅ All 91 URLs verified
- ✅ All object numbers unique (no duplicates)
- ✅ Complete documentation with examples

All files are in `/mnt/user-data/outputs/` ready to download!
